kb.datenschutz: Data protection: messengers often store data with third parties. For counselling services, print or secure e-mail is usually better.

kw.modus.vorgang: The whole case with all saved entries
kw.modus.vorgang.t: Your client gets everything saved in this case: details, household, deadlines, checklist and form entries. They can keep working with it in their SoLo app.
kw.h: Give to the client's SoLo app
kw.intro: Your client opens the content in their SoLo app under “My folder”. It is saved there as a new case.
kw.pin.hinweis: Tell your client the PIN in person. Do not send it together with the code or the file.
kw.pin.aus: Without PIN: anyone who has the code or the file can read it.
kw.wie.t: With a PIN the content is encrypted and cannot be read without the PIN. This is a privacy screen: a 6-digit PIN does not reliably protect against experts with a lot of computing time. Nothing goes through a server, the content is entirely in the code or the file.

kw.qr.hilfe: Your client: open SoLo → “My folder” → “Received from counselling” → “Scan QR code”.
